notice: Starter routing heuristics, not measured rankings or account entitlements. Intersect with host-exposed availability. Update this provider file when models change; do not relabel observed legacy settings.

gpt-6-luna.fit: Focused repeatable work with explicit rules; increase effort for consequential exceptions.

gpt-6.1-sol.fit: Implementation, debugging, automation and coordinated production; match effort to interacting risks and validation depth.

gpt-6.1-terra.fit: Visual grounding, application interaction, precise writing and editorial fidelity; match effort to ambiguity and costly details.

gpt-6-astra.fit: Cross-domain synthesis, difficult ambiguity and tightly integrated reasoning; match effort to reconciliation and defensibility.

effort_guidance.low: Explicit bounded instructions, reliable tools, minimal ambiguity.
effort_guidance.medium: Structured multi-step work, predictable exceptions, moderate judgment.
effort_guidance.high: Substantial production, implementation or synthesis with meaningful validation.
effort_guidance.xhigh: Difficult ambiguity, interacting constraints or expensive mistakes.
effort_guidance.max: Hardest tightly coupled work needing deep reasoning and costly reconciliation.
effort_guidance.ultra: Divisible orchestration, only when the host supports it and delegation is authorized. Not a stronger single-worker mode.
